title: The Upside Of Your Dark Side

questions.q: What effect does happiness have on persuasive reasoning, according to the book?
a: It reduces argument convincingness by about 25%
It has no impact on persuasion
questions.why: Study showed unhappy people's arguments were 25% more convincing.

questions.q: How does guilt influence future bad behavior, per the author's findings?
a: It lowers the likelihood of reoffending
It increases chances of repeat offenses
It has no effect on behavior
It only affects feelings, not actions
questions.why: Research linked higher guilt to less crime and lower recidivism.

questions.q: What distinction does the book make between guilt and shame?
a: Guilt drives repair, shame does not
Both lead to the same outcomes
questions.why: Guilt prompts fixing mistakes; shame is described as useless.

questions.q: Why is being fully mindful described as costly in the text?
questions.why: Mindfulness limits conscious bandwidth, slowing task execution.

questions.q: What surprising benefit does the book claim about negative feelings?
a: They can add value to life when embraced
questions.why: The premise is that bad feelings have positive side effects if embraced.
